newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle off $1 at $70 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle off $1 at $70 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was moderate in the Panhandle area Monday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were $1.00 per cwt lower. Feedlots reporting moderate inquiry.
Sales reported on 7,200 slaughter steers and 5,200 heifers; 28,800 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 12,200 formulated and 200 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 70.00, pen Certified Hereford 72.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 70.00. Pen Select, few Choice 2-4 1250 lbs including heiferettes 69.00.
Confirmed - 12,400 Week Ago - None Year Ago - 6,300
Wk to Date - 28,800 Week Ago - None Year Ago - 10,800
